responsibility: Defines the Rust HIR expression class hierarchy. It introduces the abstract split between ExprWithBlock and ExprWithoutBlock and declares concrete HIR nodes for literals, operators, borrows, calls, field access, tuples, blocks, control-flow constructs, matches, awaits, async blocks, closures, ranges, and related expression metadata, including cloning, visitor hooks, source locations, outer attributes, and expression-kind queries. This file is the core structural model for expression nodes consumed by later analysis, type checking, and code generation.
